summary: Sandbach United got their 2026/27 season off to a winning start with a 3-1 victory over league newcomers Wednesfield in today's first league fixture. The Ramblers dominated possession throughout and showed great cohesion early on with five new players in the starting lineup, with Bevan grabbing two goals in an impressive display. It was a solid opening day performance and a perfect way to kick off the campaign with three points on the board.
